explanation.definitionFit: Montevideo is the capital city of Uruguay, on the River Plate.

clue.text: A club honour follows the four of diamonds

clue.text: Blue or White flower

explanation.walkthrough: Flower is a crossword favourite for a river; the Blue and White branches meet at Khartoum.
explanation.definitionFit: The Blue and White branches join at Khartoum to form the great river running north through Egypt.

clue.text: In a letter or note, arm a politician

taken as written

clue.text: Not suitable in a small part

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written
pt is the short form of part

clue.text: Pack up and talk in detail

clue.text: A religious leader. I am a Frenchman

clue.text: A large man, one oddly to do with running

clue.text: Stop working in island — work round woman

clue.text: … avoided work — or sounded thus

second meaning: measured the depth of water with a weighted line

explanation.definitionFit: The British idiom for shirking comes from the leadsman's task of taking soundings with a weighted line.

clue.text: Transport I got was not an automobile

clue.text: Forgiveness for using only half the soap in washing

clue.text: Lake resembling, they say, a musical instrument

clue.text: Swelling even in a bump on the head

clue.text: Never disturbed one's cool

parts.note: the letters to be rearranged

clue.text: Beginning the attack

clue.text: It eases traffic after red changes to green in the middle

clue.text: Cargo is kept out of sight
